input.quote: (e) not use the Work except as authorized herein;
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete or field-of-use restraint on Sparkling. Section 3 (Restrictions on Use) is limited to conventional software-licence protections (no copying beyond backup, no sublicence/transfer, no reverse engineering, use only as authorized) and does not restrict the businesses we may operate or the products we may buy or build. Section 2 grants a non-exclusive licence with no exclusivity or minimum-purchase commitment on us; Section 14 (Confidentiality) preserves an independent-development carve-out (p0098) rather than a residual-use restraint; and Section 19 is a mutual employee non-solicit (a separate category, and reciprocal). Sweeps for "compet", "similar", "exclusive" and "shall not develop/market/sell/engage" returned no restrictive covenant binding us. This meets the preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer), so no redline is required.
